lanes.cutoutCoverage: No cutout or simple notch acceptable
lanes.purpose: Catch low-memory, older-platform, touch-latency and baseline 30 FPS regressions.
Primary soft-launch quality lane for controls, safe area, missions, water and sustained performance.
Validate current Google Play target-platform compatibility, cutout behavior and modern Android runtime changes.

scenarios.name: Install and cold launch
scenarios.passCriteria: APK installs, launches from a cold state, reaches gameplay without crash, missing script, black screen or fatal error.

scenarios.name: Tutorial onboarding
scenarios.passCriteria: Steer -> GO -> REV -> ACTION progresses with real touch input; Skip works; completion/skip remains suppressed after relaunch.

scenarios.name: Driving controls and multitouch
scenarios.passCriteria: LEFT/RIGHT with GO/REV combinations respond consistently with no stuck input, missed release or accidental UI blocking.

scenarios.name: Parking, cook and repair interactions
scenarios.passCriteria: Parking, cooking and repair start/complete/cancel correctly through the shared ACTION interaction path.

scenarios.name: Mechanic job and credits
scenarios.passCriteria: Mechanic job completes once, awards the expected credits once, and HUD remains readable/non-blocking.

scenarios.name: Mission progression and save/relaunch
scenarios.passCriteria: Reach/exploration progression completes and persisted progress restores correctly after force-close and relaunch.

scenarios.name: Forest survival
scenarios.passCriteria: Forest context activates/resets correctly and survival state remains playable without new performance or UI regressions.

scenarios.name: Restricted-area puzzle gate
scenarios.passCriteria: Puzzle reliably blocks/unlocks the gate, supports retry/reset, and integrates with mission completion.

scenarios.name: Swim, dive and camera handoff
scenarios.passCriteria: DRIVE -> SWIM TEST -> DRIVE, SWIM/BACK/DIVE/SURFACE and single-camera target handoff work without stuck controls or camera loss.

scenarios.name: Safe area and HUD readability
scenarios.passCriteria: Mission/Tutorial/Performance/Mechanic/interaction HUD stays clear of cutouts, rounded corners and gesture navigation with no intentional overlap.

scenarios.name: Real gameplay screenshot capture
scenarios.passCriteria: At least three representative 16:9 landscape gameplay captures can be taken from the real build without debug overlays or misleading fabricated content.

scenarios.name: Sustained play and thermal check
scenarios.passCriteria: At least 15 minutes of mixed driving/interactions/water play completes without crash, severe thermal throttling, runaway memory symptoms or sustained FPS below the accepted device-tier threshold.
